title: Sesotho and Tshivenda Vegetables establishment repaired candidates final semantic check

entries.sourceEnglish: Compacted soil loses its air spaces. Roots slow down. Water soaks in differently. The bed gets harder to work every season.

entries.finding: Retains the exact compaction/air-space mechanism; local wording states roots grow slowly, water soaks differently, and the bed gets harder to work each season. Corrected Maḓi spelling is present.
